risk_note: RV2 (console articles CMS). Six /admin/v1/articles* operations on permission point content.article (no step-up; the two GETs read-only). Create checks a lowercase UUIDv7 client id, refuses category agreement, runs the F1-02v save checks and answers 20902 resource=article when the id exists under any app (articles key has no app_id; concurrent creates colliding on the key also map to 20902). Save draft inserts a new version row (row_version rule L36), save checks before CAS; publish / offline lock the article's rows, CAS first, then state checks (and save checks on publish); state changes only through the generated transitionArticleVersion; only the five columns 0049 grants are updated; audit in the same transaction, any failure rolls back. union_host_block counts as on when missing; with MEDIA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL unset no image host is allowed. Rule test #29 seeded an id that collided with the kit's own id sequence and was fixed mechanically by the orchestrator before the implementation. No funds. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
